broadcast.jpg.description: A camera operator at the 2020 U.S. Open in New York using a tripod-mounted hard camera equipped with a Fujinon UA107×8.4 4K box lens. An overhead umbrella and head-and-neck covering provide sun protection during extended outdoor broadcast operation. The UA107×8.4 lens offers a 107× zoom range, allowing broadcasters to capture tight player close-ups and fast-moving ball action from long distances; an essential requirement for tennis coverage.
broadcast.jpg.author: AndrewHenkelman
